post.caption:
The Mariana Trench is nearly 11 km deep. Drop Everest in and the summit is still 2 km underwater. Pressure at the bottom is over 1,000 atmospheres, about a tonne on every square centimetre, and more people have been to the Moon than to the bottom. There is still life down there.
